name: Greenlee
notes: Emerson-owned. Production Bend Pro charts use Site-Rite hand benders. Also markets 555/854 electric, 1800/1801 mechanical (Chicago-style ratchet), 880/881 hydraulic.

name: Klein Tools
notes: Angle Setter hand bender family 51603–51613. Official product pages publish centerline radius and stub take-up on specs.

name: Gardner Bender
notes: ECM Industries brand. BigBen hand (960/961/962); Sidewinder mechanical/electric; Portable Cyclone B1000; Ultra Eegor / Eegor hydraulic; one-shot hydraulic lines.

name: IDEAL
notes: Hand bender 74-xxx aluminum and ductile iron. Production URLs use idealelectricalinc.com; newer beta.idealindustries.com pages also exist for same SKUs. Benfield-system markings referenced on product copy.

name: Milwaukee
notes: Hand benders 48-22-407x aluminum and 48-22-408x iron. Official pages/manual confirm models and offset/saddle tables; no published stub take-up inches or centerline radius.

name: Southwire
notes: MCB hand bender family MCB1/2, MCB3/4, MCB1. Cutsheet lists models/capacity only; no stub take-up or radius published.

name: Current Tools
notes: Electric 77 Series, 747 Omni, 797 IQ Bender; hydraulic 254 Series. Shoes marketed as compatible with Greenlee 555 Classic / 881CT in official catalog notes.

name: Rack-A-Tiers
notes: Hoppy Bender precision hand system (57050/57075); Skybender lift-mounted EMT bender. Canadian store rack-a-tiers.ca mirrors catalog.

name: NSI Industries
notes: Cast aluminum hand benders CB50/CB75/CB100. TORK is an NSI controls/timers brand — not conduit benders.

name: RIDGID
notes: Thin-wall (EMT) and heavy-wall cast iron hand bender heads exist on official site. Inside-radius specs published; handles sold separately. Limited shoe-chart detail vs Greenlee/Klein.

name: Benfield (legacy)
notes: Historical inventor/methodology and marking system, not a current bender OEM. Gates/manuals sold via trade publishers (EC&M). Many modern hand benders claim Benfield-style markings. Do not treat as active manufacturer SKU source.

name: Emerson
notes: Corporate parent for Greenlee and RIDGID tool brands. Chicago-style ratchet benders persist as Greenlee 1800/1801 product pages, not a separate Emerson SKU line.
